pain.label: Pain
pain.standard: SOCRATES pain history (Site, Onset, Character, Radiation, Associations, Time course, Exacerbating/relieving, Severity); NICE CKS symptom histories

substance.label: Anything that comes out (phlegm, vomit, stool, urine, discharge)
substance.standard: Bristol Stool Form Scale for stool; standard clinical history of sputum/vomit/urine/discharge (amount, colour, consistency, smell, blood, timing); WHO IMCI for vomit and diarrhoea; Med-Log spec CLAUDE.md 4b chain

bleeding.label: Bleeding
bleeding.standard: NICE CKS bleeding/epistaxis; WHO Emergency Triage Assessment and Treatment (ETAT) shock signs; first-aid haemorrhage control (direct pressure)

skin.label: Skin problem
skin.standard: British Association of Dermatologists / NICE CKS rash history (distribution, morphology, itch, spread, triggers, systemic features, contacts)

swelling.label: Swelling or lump
swelling.standard: NICE CKS lumps and swellings; NICE NG12 suspected cancer recognition (size, change, systemic features)

breathing.label: Breathing
breathing.standard: MRC dyspnoea scale and NYHA (exertion tolerance, orthopnoea); BTS/SIGN asthma and NICE CKS breathlessness histories; WHO IMCI cough or difficult breathing

neuro.label: Brain and nerves
neuro.standard: FAST/BE-FAST stroke screen; ABCD2 for TIA; ILAE seizure history; NICE CKS headache and dizziness

collapse.label: Faint, fit or blackout
collapse.standard: NICE CG109 transient loss of consciousness; ESC syncope guideline history

systemic.label: Whole-body symptom
systemic.standard: NICE CKS fever, fatigue, weight loss and dehydration; WHO IMCI general danger signs and hydration

mind.label: Mood, worry or thoughts
mind.standard: PHQ-9, GAD-7 and PHQ-2 domains; NICE CG90/CG113; Columbia suicide-risk screen (safety)

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.standard: Consensus Sleep Diary items; STOP-BANG and Epworth Sleepiness Scale; NICE CKS insomnia

injury.label: Injury
injury.standard: Ottawa ankle/knee rules; Canadian CT Head and NICE NG232 head injury; ATLS mechanism-of-injury history

sensation.label: Numbness, tingling or weakness
sensation.standard: Neurological symptom history (distribution, pattern, weakness, progression); NICE CKS peripheral neuropathy and spinal cord compression red flags

eye_ear_nose_throat.label: Eye or ear
eye_ear_nose_throat.standard: NICE CKS red eye, otitis, hearing loss, tinnitus; Royal College of Ophthalmologists red-eye triage

nose_throat.label: Nose and throat
nose_throat.standard: NICE CKS sore throat (FeverPAIN/Centor), sinusitis, rhinitis, hoarseness, epistaxis

mouth_teeth.label: Mouth and teeth
mouth_teeth.standard: NICE CKS dental abscess, mouth ulcers, oral cancer red flags (3-week rule)

urinary_bowel_function.label: Passing urine or stool
urinary_bowel_function.standard: NICE CKS lower urinary tract symptoms, UTI, constipation, diarrhoea; Bristol Stool Form Scale; IPSS symptom domains

digestive.label: Stomach and swallowing
digestive.standard: Rome IV functional GI symptom domains; NICE CG184 dyspepsia/GORD; NICE CKS dysphagia and nausea

womens.label: Women's health
womens.standard: FIGO abnormal uterine bleeding (PALM-COEIN) history; NICE CKS menorrhagia, menopause, breast symptoms; NICE NG12 post-menopausal bleeding

heart.label: Heart rate and rhythm
heart.standard: EHRA symptom classification; NICE CG180 atrial fibrillation; ESC palpitation history

reading_monitoring.label: Home reading (BP, sugar, oxygen)
reading_monitoring.standard: NICE NG136 hypertension, NG17/NG28 diabetes hypo/hyperglycaemia, BTS oxygen saturation guidance; NEWS2 bands

daily_function.label: Managing daily life
daily_function.standard: Barthel Index / Katz ADL and Lawton IADL domains; NICE NG249 falls and frailty

medicine_effect.label: Medicine effect
medicine_effect.standard: WHO-UMC causality assessment and Naranjo adverse-drug-reaction questions (drug, timing, dechallenge)

dimensions.onset: When and how fast it began (sudden or gradual).
dimensions.course: Whether it is getting better, worse or staying the same.
dimensions.severity: How bad it is, on a 0-10 scale or simple bands.
dimensions.impact: How it affects daily life: sleep, walking, eating, work, bathing.
dimensions.tried: What the person has already taken or done for it, and whether it helped.
dimensions.danger: Screens for a danger sign that needs urgent care.
dimensions.site: Where exactly on the body it is.
dimensions.character: What it feels like or how it behaves (sharp, dull, burning, forceful).
dimensions.radiation: Whether it spreads or moves to another place.
dimensions.associated: Other symptoms that come with it.
dimensions.timing: When in the day or in relation to events it happens and for how long.
dimensions.any: Whether anything actually came out or was seen.
dimensions.amount: How much, or how many times.
dimensions.shade: Whether the colour is pale or dark.
dimensions.consistency: Thick, thin, watery, hard, soft, mucus, clots.
dimensions.smell: Whether it has an unusual or bad smell.
dimensions.blood: Whether there is blood in it, and how much.
dimensions.duration_of_bleeding: How long the bleeding has gone on.
dimensions.stops_with_pressure: Whether bleeding stops with firm pressure.
dimensions.cause_trigger: What caused or set off the bleeding.
dimensions.anticoagulant: Whether they take a blood thinner or aspirin.
dimensions.faint_from_loss: Whether they feel faint, dizzy or weak from blood loss.
dimensions.distribution: Where on the body it is and whether it is one side or both.
dimensions.appearance: What it looks like (flat, raised, blistered, open, dead-looking).
dimensions.itch_pain: Whether it itches, burns or hurts.
dimensions.spread: Whether it is spreading to other places.
dimensions.triggers: What set it off (food, sting, medicine, sun, contact).
dimensions.fever: Whether there is fever or shivering, and the temperature.
dimensions.contacts: Whether others around them have the same problem.
dimensions.size: How big it is (coin, palm, growing).
dimensions.colour_warmth: Whether the area is red or hot.
dimensions.tenderness: Whether it is sore when touched.
dimensions.change: Whether it is getting bigger, smaller or changing shape.
dimensions.systemic: Whole-body signs with it such as fever, weight loss, night sweats.
dimensions.exertion_tolerance: How much walking or climbing brings on breathlessness.
dimensions.at_rest: Whether it happens even when resting.
dimensions.lying_flat: Whether it is worse lying flat, or how many pillows are needed.
dimensions.wheeze: Whether there is wheezing or noisy breathing.
dimensions.cough: Whether there is cough, dry or wet, and for how long.
dimensions.chest_pain: Whether there is chest pain or pressure with it.
dimensions.swelling: Whether legs, ankles or face are swollen.
dimensions.speed_of_onset: How quickly it came on: seconds, minutes, hours, days.
dimensions.pattern: Whether it is constant or comes and goes, and the pattern of episodes.
dimensions.one_sided: Whether it affects only one side of the body.
dimensions.consciousness: Whether there was loss of consciousness, confusion or drowsiness.
dimensions.warning_before: Whether there was warning first (sweat, sick, sight dimming).
dimensions.duration_unresponsive: How long they were out or unresponsive.
dimensions.position_trigger: Whether it happens on standing up or changing position.
dimensions.recovery: How they recovered, and whether they could get up alone.
dimensions.heart_symptoms: Chest pain, racing heart or effort with it.
dimensions.injury_from: Whether they were hurt during the episode.
dimensions.first_time: Whether this is the first time it has happened.
dimensions.duration: How long the problem has been present.
dimensions.trend: Whether the overall direction is better, worse or unchanged.
dimensions.amount_of_change: How much weight or appetite has changed.
dimensions.fluids_intake: How much they are drinking and keeping down, and urine passed.
dimensions.function: Whether they can manage usual tasks and social contact.
dimensions.safety: Thoughts of harm to self or others, and whether they are safe now.
dimensions.sleep_pattern: Trouble falling asleep, waking at night or waking too early.
dimensions.daytime_effect: Sleepiness or function problems in the day.
dimensions.breathing_in_sleep: Snoring, pauses in breathing or waking breathless.
dimensions.night_waking: Waking at night and what wakes them.
dimensions.substances: Caffeine, alcohol, nicotine or sedative use around sleep.
dimensions.mechanism: How the injury or event happened.
dimensions.weight_bearing: Whether they can stand, walk or use the part.
dimensions.deformity: Whether it looks bent, out of shape or has an open wound.
dimensions.constant_or_comes_and_goes: Whether it is always there or comes and goes.
dimensions.weakness: Whether there is weakness and where.
dimensions.side: Which side: left, right or both.
dimensions.pain: Whether there is pain and how much.
dimensions.swelling_redness: Whether the area is swollen or red.
dimensions.discharge_or_blockage: Runny or blocked nose, and what comes out.
dimensions.smell_taste: Loss or change of smell or taste.
dimensions.trigger_or_allergy: Allergy or what sets it off (dust, pollen, pets, cold).
dimensions.eating_drinking: Whether it stops eating, drinking or opening the mouth.
dimensions.ulcer_or_patch: Ulcers, sores or white or red patches and how many.
dimensions.frequency: How often it happens, or how many times.
dimensions.control: Whether they can hold or control urine or stool, or empty fully.
dimensions.pain_passing: Pain or burning when passing urine or stool.
dimensions.night: Whether it happens at night or wakes them.
dimensions.meal_relation: How it relates to eating (before, after, early fullness).
dimensions.swallowing: Whether swallowing is hard, painful or food sticks.
dimensions.cycle_or_bleeding_pattern: Periods: timing, length, flow, late or absent.
dimensions.age_context: Age, pregnancy, menopause or hormone use that changes meaning.
dimensions.rate_regularity: Pulse rate and whether the beat is steady or uneven.
dimensions.exertion_link: Whether it comes on with effort.
dimensions.faint_dizzy: Whether they feel faint or dizzy with it.
dimensions.reading: The measured number (BP, sugar, oxygen, pulse, temperature).
dimensions.known_condition: Known diagnosis such as diabetes or high blood pressure.
dimensions.on_treatment: Whether they take regular treatment for it.
dimensions.symptoms_with: Symptoms that came with the reading.
dimensions.recent_change: Recent change in treatment, diet or health.
dimensions.cause_or_pain: What makes the activity hard: pain, weakness, breathlessness.
dimensions.aids_or_help: Aids or help used or needed.
dimensions.safety_risk: Risk of falls, choking or accidents.
dimensions.since_when: How long daily function has been affected.
dimensions.timing_vs_dose: When it began compared with taking the medicine.
dimensions.new_or_changed: Whether a medicine or routine is new or changed.
dimensions.stopped_helps: Whether it eases when the medicine is stopped or held.
